mainEntity.name: Can AI help me create and sell an online course from scratch?

acceptedAnswer.text: A small business owner can use AI to draft a course outline, create slides and lesson scripts, prepare a workbook, and develop a launch sequence, but the product still needs a clear audience, useful instruction, quality review, and customer feedback. Run My AI Biz connects digital-product creation with sales pages, lead magnets, funnels, email follow-up, and ongoing operations. Context: generating course files is only one part of creating a viable offer. Key factors: customer problem, learning outcome, product scope, evidence of demand, delivery platform, support burden, and price. Practical guidance: validate the topic with conversations, a small sample, or a low-risk pilot before producing a large course. Separate educational value from promotional copy and review both independently. Run My AI Biz presents possible workflows, not guaranteed sales or income.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, it can support research, outlines, slides, scripts, workbooks, sales copy, funnels, and follow-up. Validate the audience and topic first, review every lesson, and treat sales as unproven until customers respond.
